{{For|[[Soccer Ball]]|[[Soccer Head]], [[Soccer Goal]]|[[Speedy]]}} {{EventSandboxOnly|date=12th of June 2026|event=[[Backyard Legends Event]]}} {{Zombie |title1 = Soccer Speedy |image1 = |-|Animation 1 = [[File:SoccerSpeedy1.png]] |-|Animation 2 = [[File:SoccerSpeedy2.png]] |-|Animation 3 = [[File:SoccerSpeedy3.png]] |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via [[Logbooks]] ---- Originally:
[[Competition Court|Backyard Legends Mission 2 (Hard)]] |first_wave_appearance = 10 |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]1,300 |speed = 4 |cash = {{Money|5}} on death |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} ==Description== The '''Soccer Speedy''' was a fast enemy from the [[Backyard Legends Event]] that only appeared in the Hard difficulty of [[Competition Court]]. It was essentially a stronger version of the [[Sports Drink]], having the same speed but way higher health. ==Appearance== The '''Soccer Speedy''' is a black humanoid with a black and yellow soccer ball for a head, it wears a dark grey adidas polyester shirt, black shorts, black adidas shoes with yellow laces and has dark grey armbands. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |10% |130 |- !Wave !Health |- |11 |1,430 |- |12 |1,560 |- |13 |1,690 |- |14 |1,820 |- |15 |1,950 |- |16 |2,080 |- |17 |2,210 |- |18 |2,340 |- |19 |2,470 |- |20 |2,600 |} ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Assassin]], [[Trapper]] or [[Militant]] can be used to take this down. **Towers like the [[Trapper]]'s bear traps can be used to stall it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} SoccerSpeedyCorpse1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (22 May 2026 – Present) SoccerSpeedyCorpse2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (22 May 2026 – Present) SoccerSpeedyCorpse3.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, 3rd animation variant (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} adidas Backyard Legends Trailer ⚽ - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Soccer Speedy''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SoccerSpeedyIconIG.png|'''Soccer Speedy''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Soccer Speedy''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. *The '''Soccer Speedy''' only spawns once in [[Competition Court]] on the Hard difficulty and never again. *The '''Soccer Speedy''', [[Fey Yoshida]] and the [[Health Cultist]] are the only non-boss [[Enemies]] that spawn once in their respective [[gamemodes]]. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Soccer Speedy''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Soccer Speedy's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Soccer Speedy''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{CompetitionCourt|[[Duffle Bag]]|Wave 9|[[Referee]] & Soccer Speedy| Wave 10 (Hard)|[[Crowd Pleaser]]|Wave 11}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
